themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, analyze data, and generate insights, acting as intelligent assistants or collaborators.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools and research related to generating, assisting with, or analyzing code, including their impact on developer workflows and research.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines the effects of AI on jobs, hiring, skill requirements, and the overall employment landscape, including studies on job displacement and augmentation.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Highlights new platforms, tools, and systems designed to accelerate or enhance the research process, from data discovery to analysis and experimentation.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Explores AI's application in the design process, from UI/UX design and prototyping to generative design and creating design systems.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Focuses on AI's ability to condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries, abstracts, or key takeaways for research and analysis.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Investigates the use, impact, and research surrounding AI-powered chatbots, including their effectiveness, ethical considerations, and user interactions.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Covers the creation and use of synthetic data, digital twins, or simulated users for training AI models, testing products, and conducting research without real user data.

themes.name: AI survey tools
themes.description: Details AI functionalities integrated into survey platforms for creation, analysis, and optimization of research questionnaires and data collection.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Focuses on the testing, comparison, and reviews of various AI tools and platforms, assessing their performance, features, and suitability for specific tasks.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
